vo2max-elite.label: VO₂max of champion endurance athletes
vo2max-elite.value: 70–85 mL·kg⁻¹·min⁻¹ in men; elite women about 10% lower

vo2max-age-decline.label: Fall in VO₂max with age
vo2max-age-decline.value: about 10% per decade after age 25–30, speeding up in old age (over 20% per decade in the 70s)
